newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill lifts Kredyt rating to "neutral".
newsitem.headline: Merrill lifts Kredyt rating to "neutral".

text.p: Merrill Lynch in London has increased its rating for Polish bank Kredyt Bank SA to neutral from reduce, as the bank looks likely to turn significant profits in 1996 and 1997, Merrill said in a report.

"After reviewing (nine-month) results which were 109 percent above 1995, due mainly to revenue growth, we have significantly raised our 1996 and 1997 earnings forecasts. We now expect net income to double in 1996 and 1997," Merrill said in its January European Emerging Markets Strategy report.
Merrill predicted Kredyt Bank's net income to rise to 21.2 million zlotys in 1996 and 43.3 million zlotys in 1997 from 10.3 million zlotys in 1995.
Last week the bank released a preliminary net profit figure of 23.2 million zlotys for 1996.
Merrill also said the bank's 50-percent capital increase in 1996 would likely be the last for some time.
